This platform is still a work in progress and is currently in its beta stage. I'm currently in the middle of my own review, so some subjects, lessons, exams, and other content may still be incomplete or unavailable for now.

The exams and other materials currently available on the platform are intended to help provide review resources during this beta period. As development continues, these materials may be reviewed, updated, replaced, or removed. The long-term goal is to develop and provide original examinations, lessons, explanations, and other review materials created specifically for aerodynadmics.

Please also note that some answer keys are reproduced from their respective source materials and have not yet been fully independently verified. As a result, some questions, choices, solutions, or answer keys may contain errors or inconsistencies. Please use the materials as supplementary review resources and verify information against reliable references when necessary.

Thank you for your patience and understanding as aerodynadmics continues to develop. Your support and feedback help make the platform better for future Aeronautical Engineering examinees.

A note about this website

This site was built with the help of Artificial Intelligence. aerodynadmics is built by an Aeronautical Engineering graduate, not a coder, and AI helped turn an idea into something usable for fellow Aeronautical Engineering students/graduates.

aerodynadmics knows AI use isn't environmentally free and doesn't want to brush past that. But aerodynadmics believes how and why we use a tool matters as much as whether we use it at all. Here, it went toward making review materials easier to access and organize.

“Maybe it's less about AI being good or bad, and more about the purpose we choose to use it for, while still acknowledging its impact on our environment and starting the change with ourselves to help protect it.”
- aerodynadmics

A note on Flight Store purchases

When you spend Wings in the Flight Store, that amount is treated as a voluntary contribution supporting this platform's continued development, maintenance, and hosting costs. It is not a direct commercial purchase of goods or services in the traditional sense. This platform is a passion project built and maintained independently, and every contribution helps keep it running and improving for the aerodynadmics community.

That said, the cosmetic item associated with your contribution (avatar decoration, callsign animation, or profile background) remains yours. Once unlocked, it stays tied to your account and is available for you to equip, unequip, and use freely within the platform for as long as your account exists here.

By purchasing an item, you acknowledge that this platform does not claim ownership over the cosmetic assets made available here. These cosmetics are provided for decorative, non-commercial use within the platform only, and neither the platform nor you, as a supporter, hold proprietary rights over them. What your contribution supports is the platform itself, not the acquisition of a proprietary asset. Through continued support from the community, the developer intends to eventually introduce original, first-party items that are genuinely owned and offered for sale, distinct from the cosmetics currently available.

Use of these items is granted under fair use within this platform only. They are intended for personal display and enjoyment while using this site, are non-transferable between accounts, and may not be extracted, redistributed, resold, or used outside this platform. Access to an item may be revoked in cases of account bans, abuse, or violation of the platform's community guidelines, since it remains part of the shared system rather than a separately owned asset.

If any rights holder believes an asset made available here shouldn't be, the platform will remove or replace it promptly upon notice. This platform aims to operate in good faith and has no intent to infringe on anyone's rights.

By using the Flight Store, you acknowledge that your contribution supports the platform itself, and that the associated item is provided as a token of appreciation rather than as a standalone product being sold.

Why does aerodynadmics charge Wings for custom profile background but not for avatars?

Some of you might wonder why aerodynadmics charges a small amount of Wings when you upload a custom profile background or GIF, while profile avatars remain completely free.

The simple answer is that aerodynadmics wants avatars to remain a free and basic part of the platform. aerodynadmics doesn't want someone to feel like they have to spend Wings just to have a profile picture. It's one of those small things that aerodynadmics believes everyone should be able to enjoy without worrying about a cost.

Custom backgrounds and GIFs are a little different. When you upload them, aerodynadmics has to store those files on its cloud storage and keep them hosted so they can continue to appear on your profile. Larger and more numerous files mean more storage and hosting costs for aerodynadmics as it continues running the platform.

The Wings fee isn't meant to punish anyone for uploading an image, and it's not a charge for the image itself. It's simply aerodynadmics' way of helping cover some of the ongoing costs of providing that extra customization feature.

aerodynadmics could make everything paid, but doesn't want to. It would rather keep the basic features, like avatars, freely available and only charge for optional features that require additional resources to maintain.

aerodynadmics is being built independently, and every part of the platform comes with real costs behind the scenes. aerodynadmics wants to be honest about that rather than pretending these features are completely free to operate.

Thank you for understanding and for supporting what aerodynadmics is building. Every bit of support helps keep the platform running and continue improving it 🫶🌸!

A NOTE FROM THE CREATOR

This platform was created from a simple hope: to make learning, reviewing, and preparing for the AELE a little more accessible, organized, and manageable for Aeronautical Engineering students and graduates.

aerodynadmics is being developed into a more comprehensive platform for the Aeronautical Engineering community, with structured lessons, detailed explanations, and interactive animations to help make difficult concepts, especially in Aerodynamics, easier to understand and visualize.

For students, the goal is to provide a place where you can strengthen your understanding of subjects throughout your studies, explore concepts beyond the classroom, and gradually build a stronger foundation for the AELE. For AELE reviewees, the platform aims to provide accessible resources that can support your continued review and preparation for the licensure examination.

Beyond being a review and learning platform, aerodynadmics is also being developed as an online space for group study and collaboration. The idea is to give Aeronautical Engineering students and AELE reviewees an online space where they can study, exchange knowledge, discuss difficult topics, and share useful materials with others. Through an accessible online platform, studying can become more connected and less isolated.

The platform is also meant to help AELE reviewees become more comfortable with answering exams in a computerized environment. Since the AELE is conducted through a Computer-Based Licensure Examination (CBLE) setup, aerodynadmics hopes that practicing in a similar format can make the experience a little less unfamiliar when the actual examination day comes.

Everything provided for learning and review on aerodynadmics is completely free and accessible to everyone. There is no need to pay to access lessons, explanations, study resources, exams, or practice materials.

However, if you find aerodynadmics helpful and would like to support the project, you can make an optional donation by purchasing an item from the Flight Store. These purchases are not required to access any of the learning or review resources. They are simply a way for those who wish to support the platform to contribute to its continued development and maintenance.

aerodynadmics would genuinely appreciate any support. Your contribution helps keep the platform running, improve its features, and create more learning and review resources for Aeronautical Engineering students and AELE reviewees.

There is absolutely no obligation to purchase anything. Whether you choose to donate through the Flight Store or simply use and share aerodynadmics, your support already means a lot.

If you have your own review materials or exams that you would be willing to share, aerodynadmics would also be grateful to have them become part of this growing collection. Feel free to contribute a file, and aerodynadmics will work on getting it published. The goal is to build a place where Aeronautical Engineering students and AELE reviewees can find exams and review materials from different sources, so no one has to feel like they are preparing alone or searching everywhere for something to practice with.

Thank you for taking the time to use this platform, for supporting it in whatever way you can, and for being part of its journey. aerodynadmics hopes it can be even a small help as you work toward your goals in Aeronautical Engineering, whether you are still studying or preparing for the AELE.

Thank you, and best of luck to all future Aeronautical Engineers ✈️!

Notice Regarding Exam Materials

If you recognize an exam, question, file, or other material that you believe belongs to you or your institution, please note that this platform may contain materials gathered from publicly accessible online sources, as well as files voluntarily submitted by users through the "Contribute a File" form.

These materials are currently being made available for educational and review purposes during the beta development of the platform. The materials shared at this stage are intended to be temporary and are not necessarily part of the platform’s permanent content. As the platform continues to develop, these materials may be reviewed, replaced, or removed.

aerodynadmics does not claim ownership of materials created by other individuals, schools, organizations, or other copyright holders, nor does it intend to infringe upon any copyright or other intellectual property rights.

As the platform progresses beyond its beta stage, aerodynadmics intends to develop and provide original examinations and review materials created specifically for this website, with the goal of building a more organized and comprehensive review experience for future Aeronautical Engineering licensure examinees.

If you are the copyright owner or otherwise authorized to request the removal of material appearing on this platform, please raise a concern through the Copyright / Concerns form. Upon receiving a removal request, aerodynadmics will review the material and take appropriate action, including removing it when warranted.

Thank you for your understanding and for helping maintain a respectful learning environment for everyone.

DID YOU KNOW?

📌 A NOTE TO EVERYONE

You may forget today what you studied yesterday, and you may forget tomorrow what you studied today, and that is okay. Think of every lesson you study as someone you’ve just met along the way. The first meeting may leave you knowing only a name, a face, and a few words. But when you meet them again and again, you begin to recognize them, remember them, and eventually, they no longer feel like a stranger. Learning works the same way. What feels unfamiliar today may become something you know by heart tomorrow, simply because you chose to meet it again.

So keep showing up. Every encounter leaves a trace, and one day, what once felt unfamiliar will feel like something you’ve always known.
